d: Want to play the hardest cooperative 2D platformer ever? Want to finish no map ever? Want to be in pain for hours and cry, getting nothing in return? Come play DDNet with a large community of other sufferers!

rv.t: 한국인 고인물 형님들덕에 2시간동안 재미있게 즐겼습니다. 형님들아니였으면 재미를 보지 못했을거같네요.
